title: Phase 59 publishes the local-conversion, Constraint Atlas, Outcomes Watch, and technology-adoption editorial layer
summary: Twelve synthesis briefings and two dependency maps turn the existing evidence corpus into canonical reader products across five local systems, five technology-adoption rails, a cross-system constraint comparison, and the ten-item dated outcomes queue.
evidence_note: The phase reuses reviewed source and signal records. Published synthesis preserves every underlying record status, explicit evidence gap, dated stop rule, and incompatibility boundary; it adds no source, signal, promotion, gap resolution, score, ranking, or operating-outcome claim.
